Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Sanjay - 28 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Anita - 57 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Rajesh - 36 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Anjali - 26 years, daughter
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
5. Meenakshi - 35 years, friend
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand
2. The village well - a stone well, a rope and a bucket
3. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The hospital ward - Day

[Sanjay is asleep in bed in the ward. Rajesh stands near him.]

Sanjay: "What lovely weather!"

[Sanjay opens his eyes and slowly sits up in bed.]

Sanjay: "That was fun!"

[Sanjay groans in pain.]

Sanjay (laughing): "Show me too!"

Scene 2: The hospital ward - Day

Sanjay: "What a nice place."

[Sanjay checks Mother's pulse.]

Sanjay: "Mom, listen!"

[Sanjay lies down on the hospital bed.]

Sanjay (gently): "Exactly right."

[Sanjay sits in a wheelchair.]

Anita: "Hmm, I see."

[Sanjay walks to the reception desk and asks for the doctor.]

Anita: "That's easy."

[Sanjay coughs and holds his chest.]

Sanjay: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 3: The village well - Day

[Sanjay stands by the well. Anita stands near him.]

Sanjay: "Mom, look over here."

[Sanjay draws water from the well with the rope.]

Sanjay: "Careful!"

[Sanjay drinks water from his cupped hands.]

Anita: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Sanjay grinds wheat on the stone hand-mill.]

Sanjay (gently): "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 4: The main road - Day

[Sanjay stands on the road. Anjali stands near him.]

Sanjay: "What a nice place."

[Sanjay starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Sanjay: "That was fun!"

[Sanjay is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Sanjay: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Sanjay steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Anjali: "I really enjoyed today."
